Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.messaging

Class KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.messaging.KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity
@Entity public class KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity extends Object
Stores financial notification events until asynchronous delivery succeeds.

The unique event identifier supports deduplicated publication, while attempt scheduling and worker claims allow delivery to be retried after transient failures. Claim owner, expiry, and token describe the active lease; optimistic row versioning protects competing workers. Event payload version and correlation/causation identifiers preserve compatibility and traceability across service boundaries. Timestamps use Instant to represent absolute instants.
